podcast.body: Iron Butterfly was awarded the first Platinum Record for their album "In-A-Gadda-Da-Vida" in 1976. This award was introduced when the RIAA reformalized its sales certifications, with Platinum signifying sales of one million copies in the United States. "That was awarded to Iron Butterfly for Inagata De Vida."
